protocol.native_timing: Date.now immediately before returning a scenario until Date.now at the beginning of the next functions.exec submission; includes model reasoning, short submission generation, host scheduling and transport.
protocol.router_timing: Date.now immediately before route MCP invocation until its promise resolves; includes MCP/provider/network overhead.
exclusions: tool argument generation beyond the choice-recording envelope
limitations: Not pure model-compute timing; the two arms have different host envelopes.
Single growing Codex context, not independent fresh sessions; main model authored scenario templates.
Candidate-name choice benchmark, not native tool-schema function-call generation.
First-use inputs prevent intentional exact-cache hits; installed server version and internal cache/provider timings are not exposed.
